Turn on the C-Gear and
establish communications?

When communications are on, closing the
system will put it into Sleep Mode if the 
battery is low. Please watch the battery.

Will you turn C-Gear off to stop
communications?

{VAR FF00 0001}Warning!{VAR FF00 0000}
Please turn C-Gear off
in places--such as airplanes
and hospitals--where wireless
communications are prohibited.
